classification.difficultyReason: Recognise that the shared side x corresponds to different bases in the two trapezia, form x/7 = 63/x, and solve the resulting squared-length equation using the positive root.

content.prompt: Trapezia $BCFE$ and $EFDA$ are similar. Find the value of $x$.

spec.description: Joined upper and lower trapezia, with labelled vertices, three base lengths and matching single parallel marks. Source geometry is schematic.
spec.mathematics: BC corresponds to EF, and EF corresponds to AD under BCFE similar to EFDA; BC = 7 cm, EF = x cm, AD = 63 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens are visible; x remains unknown.

answer.worked:
Corresponding bases are $BC\leftrightarrow EF$ and $EF\leftrightarrow AD$.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{x}{7}&=\frac{63}{x}\\x^2&=7\times63\\x^2&=441\\x&=21\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
Take the positive value because $x$ is a length.
